title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Article 12 of the Revised Criminal Law in Procuratorial Work

articles.content_en:
III. If the law in force at the time did not consider an act to be a crime, but the revised Criminal Law considers it a crime, the law in force at the time shall apply; however, if the act is continuous or continues beyond October 1, 1997, the revised Criminal Law shall apply to investigate criminal liability for the act that constitutes a crime after October 1.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
October 6, 1997
